title: Brands you didn't know were from these countries

segments.narration: *Five countries* make almost everything you wear. Number five will surprise you.
The United States has Nike, Levi's, Calvin Klein and Ralph Lauren.
Italy has Gucci, Prada, Versace and Armani.
France has Louis Vuitton, Chanel, Dior and Yves Saint Laurent.
Japan has Uniqlo, Comme des Garçons and Onitsuka Tiger.
And number five? *Sweden*. H&M, Acne Studios and Fjällräven.
Which country did I miss? Tell me in the comments.
